# Mary Lou Bates

> Mary Lou Bates is an author and rose enthusiast from East Tennessee. She is writing a memoir about the four seasons she spent in Antarctica with her husband Michael, who spent about eight years in the U.S. Antarctic Research Program. The book's byline: "he promised her a rose garden if she would follow him to the ice." The book is not yet published.

She has published articles on rose culture in the New Zealand Rose Annual, the American Rose Annual and American Rose magazine, edited KATnips (the Tenarky District newsletter for Kentucky, Arkansas and Tennessee), and written for the Tennessee Rose Bud. She is a member of Pitch to Published and Writing Away Refuge.

## Pages

- [Home](https://maryloubates.com/): about the author, the book in progress, and a signup for news about the book.
- [Antarctic Timeline](https://maryloubates.com/timeline.html): Michael and Mary Lou's years on the ice, in New Zealand and back again.
- [Mam-Maw Sarah's Yellow Roses](https://maryloubates.com/2009-american-rose-annual.html): article in the 2009 American Rose Annual.
- [Roses Take You Away Down Memory Lane](https://maryloubates.com/2015-american-rose-annual.html): article in the 2015 American Rose Annual.

## Book news

Readers can sign up on the home page (https://maryloubates.com/#news) to hear when the memoir comes out.
